scope: Havenline T01-T80 task-plan research and GitHub render refresh; documentation only
required_checks: Resolve current main, active development refs and authentic task definitions.
Preserve all 70 existing task IDs, names, dependencies, historical approvals and invalidations; represent T71-T80 as missing-source rows.
Map every task to applicable recent research, pinned GitHub render sources, requirements, evidence gates, responsibility and next action; explicit non-applicability for nonvisual tasks.
Inspect actual reference pixels and preserve video identities/timestamps, differentiating full video, sampled frames, storyboards, primary documentation and design proposals.
Require selected GitHub renders as modeling inputs and preserve rejected/original versions; do not equate static art or archive integrity with runtime approval.
Make 9.9 reference-match attainment explicit, preserve >=9.5 ordinary critic floor and stronger exact10 style gates, all mandatory evidence and independent review.
Preserve current Level 1 choices, future full-game scope, audio coverage, species roles, monetization constraints and physical-device gates.
Update the actual production plan and navigation without changing gameplay, operational workflows, assets, task statuses or active branch assignments.
Run link/coverage/source-preservation checks; independent critic inspects frozen actual outputs; repair and recheck all found defects.
Publish authorized documentation to GitHub with expected-head protection and verify published content; preserve a resumable checkpoint for unresolved game evidence.
milestone_status_scope: Content-freeze snapshot; latest execution and delivery state is in CHECKPOINT.json.
